text:
emma: @sophie thanks for the report — can you confirm if this is only the Billing > Invoices page or other console pages too?

sophie: Billing page specifically. I can open Projects and Teams fine, but when I click Billing it immediately shows a 403 and tells me I don't have permission. I used the org admin SSO account (we're on Azure AD) and had billing_admin before the migration. :confused:

emma: Got it. Do you still see the "billing_admin" role under org > Members in the UI?

sophie: Nope — my role shows as "member" now. We didn't change anything on our side, this happened right after the SSO/claim mapping update last night.

emma: Sounds like a role mapping issue after the SSO claim change. I'm escalating to identity team. @raj can you pick this up?

raj: looking. quick question: is the customer using SCIM group sync or direct role claims?

sophie: We're on SCIM + role_claims. Our IdP team said they removed a custom claim ("x-roles") and replaced it with "roles" standard claim. They tested, said it was fine.

raj: That tracks. hypothesis: our role-sync job expects the old claim key for immediate mapping and the role backfill job didn't pick up the change. When claim key changed, group->role mapping became orphaned. Two possible reasons: (1) SCIM deltas didn't include the expected attribute so the sync removed the billing role; (2) session tokens cached the old ACL and UI shows stale info until session refresh.

mike: seeing similar incidents from another tenant earlier today. In those cases we saw the role mapping removed in DB and users had to re-login to refresh token, but the root cause was a SCIM schema mismatch.

emma: Can you share repro steps so we can confirm on our side, @sophie?

sophie: Sure — steps I did: 1) SSO-login as org admin 2) open https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/ACME/billing 3) error shows: 403 - You don't have permission to view billing 4) console network response: {"error":"permission_denied","required_role":"billing_admin"} 5) UI shows role "member" at /orgs/ACME/members

emma: Perfect, thanks. @raj please attempt the following on a test tenant: run the role-sync job against a user that had billing_admin but whose IdP mapping changed from x-roles -> roles. observe DB and session cache.

raj: running now. logs show SCIM patch delta for group membership where attribute name was missing. sample log: ```INFO  [scim-sync] received patch: { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op":"replace","value":{"members":[]}}] }``` looks like our parser treated the empty members as explicit removal.

raj: db row for user 0x8f12: roles -> ["member"] (billing_admin removed). session table still has token with claim roles:["billing_admin"], TTL 3600s.

olivia: if session token still references billing_admin, why does UI show member? are we performing RBAC lookup from DB at page render?

mike: yes, console does a live lookup to DB for permission checks; token claims are advisory. when role removed from DB you get 403. but cached session may delay some tooling.

emma: short-term workaround for customer: (A) re-add billing_admin on org members page as a manual fix, or (B) have IdP re-introduce old claim name for a window so our sync picks it up. Which is faster?

sophie: Our IdP team prefers not to reintroduce the old claim. They can, but slow. We can do manual re-add if you can confirm it won't break audit/history.

raj: manual re-add is safe — it creates a new mapping entry and doesn't affect historical SCIM events. I'll re-add billing_admin for Sophie and kick a full sync.

emma: going to perform manual fix now. @andrew please log this as a support escalation (P2) and include repro steps + tenant id.

andrew: logged as SUP-11245. assigned to identity eng and notify oncall. adding tags: sso, scim, billing, 403.

deploy-bot: deploy #release-2.8.1 to prod started by olivia — rolling updates to scim-sync service (will not affect console).

raj: manual update applied: Sophie now has billing_admin. Sophie, can you try the billing page again (log out and back in to be safe)?

sophie: Logged out, logged back in — billing page loads now. Thanks!! :tada:

emma: closing loop for customer: manual re-add + full sync fixed access. we're going to implement a resiliency fix to prevent silent removals on empty SCIM patch ops.

olivia: plan for fix (short bulleted): - tighten SCIM patch parser to treat missing members as noop instead of replace-empty - add a validation step that rejects patch ops which would orphan role mappings without explicit remove intent - add alert when role counts drop > 1 in < 5m for a tenant - add endpoint to trigger role-backfill for a tenant

raj: timeline: will ship parser guard in next patch (2.8.2) and add alerting next week. will also add an admin backfill endpoint for SRE to run.

mike: follow-up ops: run health check to find tenants with sudden role drops and notify them proactively. I can schedule a one-off job tomorrow.

andrew: internal notes: document customer workaround in KB: "Temporary fix for SSO claim rename causing 403 on Billing" and share with accounts team.

emma: Sophie, will escalate billing credits if this caused any disruption to your invoicing. please DM me estimated impact.

sophie: No lost invoices, just access. appreciate the quick help.

emma: thanks team. arch ticket created to track long-term fix: ARCH-6532. tagging identity, eng-runtime, and support.

deploy-bot: deploy #release-2.8.1 to prod finished successfully :white_check_mark:

emma: marking this thread resolved. if anything else pops up, reopen. :thumbsup:
